1. Say, "Consider the following figure," and provide a brief description.

comments.quote:
Because both loops use the same C(s), any difference between them comes from the specimen. Figure 1 compares the open-loop frequency responses L0=CH0 and Ld=CHd. Below 10 Hz, the magnitude of Ld is about 2.4 times that of L0. However, the phases of the two loops differ by less than 4° in this range. The loss of stiffness therefore mainly raises the loop gain rather than adding phase lag.
[Open-loop Bode plot of L0 and Ld, 0.5–100 Hz, with the NCF chordal curve. To be generated.]Figure 1. Open-loop frequency responses of the outer controller loop for the initial and damaged systems.
Table 1 lists the resulting margins. The gain margin falls from 16.4 dB to 6.9 dB, whereas the phase margin stays near 87°. Consequently, the NCF margin falls from 0.59 to 0.34. This is below the 0.4 guideline recommended by Gomaa et al. [1]. These trends agree with the gain-amplification mechanism reported in [1]. They also support the assumption in Section 3.1.2 that degradation scales the open-loop gain by a real factor g.
